title: Surreal Oracle Portrait
description: A surreal painting featuring a woman's profile merged with symbolic elements including a wolf-like creature with glowing patterns, floating flowers, a human hand holding a sphere, and scattered tarot cards. The composition is enclosed in red circular motifs against a dramatic, stormy sky with swirling red fabric.
